Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

How are you doing today? Sorry for the delay; I needed some time to consider whether I had more questions.

\- How can I tell whether someone is already in the CRM? Will I find out only after clicking the 'Export' button and receiving a 'duplicate' alert in CRM, or can I see this while viewing the person’s LinkedIn profile?

\- If I export data from Sales Navigator into the CRM, will it include the LinkedIn profile links rather than the Sales Navigator links, since they are different?

\- What is included in the 'Lead Management System'?

\- Will the emailing/LinkedIn chat history for leads be visible inside Hubspot?

\- How can silent leads be added to follow-up campaigns without manually doing it in MeetAlfred? To clarify, suppose we create List A and List B in the CRM and upload both to MeetAlfred. After some time, both lists contain silent leads. I then move those silent leads from the two lists into a new List C for a follow-up campaign. How can I ensure this new list is exported seamlessly to MeetAlfred without manually cleaning the former two campaigns?
